title: veronica stenophylla var. oliveri
intro: Veronica stenophylla var. oliveri, commonly known as Oliver's speedwell, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Oliver's speedwell are attributed to its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins.
